11	
12	`DivRepAffinePullback` (`Picard/DivRepAffKit.lean`) is the exact output F5 owes before the
13	affine representability equivalence is packaged.  As landed it demands FOUR fields:
14	`pull`, `pull_classify`, `isDivRepClassify_pull` and `pull_naturality`.
15	
16	The separation theorem (`Picard/DivRepClassifyZarSep.lean`) makes `pull_classify`
17	**redundant**: if the pulled class of every morphism satisfies the characterizing clause
18	for that morphism, then in particular `pull (classify F)` and `F` are both classified by
19	`classify F`, so they are equal.  This file records that.
20	
21	* `AlgebraicGeometry.pull_classify_of_isDivRepClassify_pull` — the reduction, stated for a
22	  bare `pull` function so it can be used before any package exists.
23	* `AlgebraicGeometry.DivRepAffinePullback.ofPull` — **the three-field constructor**.  A
24	  producer now owes `pull`, the clause law, and naturality; the round-trip law is derived.
25

27	it removes one of the four obligations from whoever writes it, and it is the obligation
28	that would otherwise have to be re-proved by a second cover chase.

8	/-!
9	# F5, the overlap agreement of the forward map (`informal/w4-ddr9-worksheet.md` §3.4)
10	
11	The affine forward map of DDR-9 is built by factorizing a morphism `v : overSpec k S ⟶ DivOver`
12	through the carve-chart atlas (`divScheme_exists_chartFactor`,
13	`Picard/DivSchemeAtlasFactor.lean:382` — landed), pulling the supplied universal chart family
14	back along each factorizing chart map (`divRepPullAt`), and gluing the resulting locally
15	certified classes (`DivFamZar.exists_glue_of_away_compat`).
16	
17	Gluing needs the pieces to agree on overlaps.  This file proves that they do, from the chart
18	family's own compatibility hypothesis and nothing else:
19	
20	* `AlgebraicGeometry.divRepPullAt_mapAlgHom_eq_of_chartFactor` — **the overlap agreement**.
21	  Two chart presentations of the SAME `v`, over two carriers `A`, `A'`, restrict to the same
22	  locally certified class over any common `k`/`S`-tower ring `B`.
23	
24	This is the whole of §3.4's family-side W3, and it is free of the DDR9-U ε-identity U2: the
25	overlap of two presentations of one morphism is exactly the input `DivRepChartFamily.IsCompatible`
26	is stated to supply.  U2 is what will *prove* `IsCompatible` for the universal family; it is not
27	needed to *use* it.
28	
29	What remains for the forward map after this file is the choice bookkeeping (glue, then show the
30	glued class is independent of the factorization) and the two U2-gated laws; see the roadmap row
31	`AJCR.w4-rep.datum.dat-d.ddr.divrep`.
32	-/

noncomputable def divUniversalFst (i : (glueData k g r₁).J) (j : (glueData k g r₂).J) :

      (DivCarveChartRing k A B g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ i j) S] :
    divCarveIdeal k A B g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ i j

  intro x hx
  rw [RingHom.mem_ker, IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply (PairChartRing k g r₁ g r₂ i j)
    (DivCarveChartRing k A B g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ i j) S, Ideal.Quotient.algebraMap_eq,

algebra `S` of the `Z(♦)`-chart ring, the pulled-back tautological pair satisfies the

theorem divUniversal_carve
    (i : (glueData k g r₁).J) (j : (glueData k g r₂).J) (S : Type u) [CommRing S]
    [Algebra k S] [Algebra (PairChartRing k g r₁ g r₂ i j) S]
    [IsScalarTower k (PairChartRing k g r₁ g r₂ i j) S]
    [Algebra (DivCarveChartRing k A B g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ i j) S]
    [IsScalarTower (PairChartRing k g r₁ g r₂ i j)
      (DivCarveChartRing k A B g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ i j) S]
    (s : ↥(divisorSections k A ⊤)) :
